summary: Phase 1 should harden execution truth, legacy control-path auth, runtime isolation, rollback integrity, and observability without rewriting the modular monolith.
findings: backend/services/task_service.py is the execution truth boundary for status, logs, provider output, and preview restart.
backend/main.py still exposes legacy /api/* control paths through get_legacy_user(), creating a privileged compatibility surface.
backend/services/site_service.py and docker-compose.yml currently leave host-level execution paths enabled by default.
backend/services/version_service.py already owns snapshot/rollback and is the right seam for rollback hardening.
backend/core/metrics.py is the existing observability entry point and should be extended instead of adding a new telemetry path.
